title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-10-25
source: SBD Master Reel > ? > DAT > CD-R > EAC (secure) > SHN

ai_review.summary: Solid sound‑board capture (a bit thin) of a fall ’73 show that shines on Dark Star, the Mind‑Left‑Body jam and a killer Let It Grow > … sequence.
ai_review.review: The performance is highlighted by an ethereal Dark Star, a spectacular Mind‑Left‑Body jam and a soaring Let It Grow > … transition that many fans call one of the best of ’73.  The soundboard source is generally clear but a few reviewers note a thin mix, yet it remains listenable enough to let the improvisational fireworks shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 5‑star and praise multiple jams; only minor criticism about thin sound and a lukewarm first set, yielding an overall strong show rating combined with decent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard source but described as a bit thin by some listeners; no major drop‑outs or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is praised as a free‑flowing, uplifting experience; first set is considered uneven by a few reviewers but contains high points like the MLBJ and Playing in the Band.
